title: No explicit top-scorers tool (spec lists it as optional)
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Mcp/ToolRegistry.cs:24 registers 7 tools; none return per-player top scorers. The spec marks this 'if inferable from data', and the FIFA dataset has no goal totals, so it is not a required capability.
suggestion: None required; biggest-wins/league aggregates in league_stats already cover R10.
